evidence: Cleans up includes across `src/test/fuzz` and adds `test/lint/lint-include-guards.py`.
rationale: Fixes IWYU warnings across fuzz test targets and adds an include-guard linter to prevent header inclusion ambiguity. While test code cleanliness and static analysis enforcement rank lower than catching regressions or adding coverage, establishing IWYU enforcement in CI prevents future include bitrot across fuzz harnesses.
